documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Audio Recording Of Earnings Call Q4
Schedule Of Earning Concall Of Q4 & FY26 With Analysts And Investors On Wednesday, June 03, 2026

analysis.summary: Sunrakshakk Industries India Limited reported its highest ever revenue and profitability for FY26, driven by a strong scale-up in its FMCG, FMCG intermediates, and edible businesses. The successful commissioning of the Guwahati facility and preferential fundraise significantly enhanced manufacturing capabilities and the balance sheet. Management reiterated its medium-term aspiration to achieve approximately INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY28 through organic growth and existing capacities. Furthermore, the company aims to improve PAT margins to around 7% in the near future while maintaining prudent capital allocation. Sunrakshakk Industries India Limited reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results, highlighting record-high revenues and profitability driven by its transition into a diversified, growth-led FMCG company.

guidance.claim: Management stated its medium-term aspiration is to achieve approximately INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY28.
guidance.quote: As shared earlier, our medium-term aspirations remain to achieve approximately INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY28.

guidance.claim: The company expects an organic growth of 10% to 15% every year over and above the annualized run rate of INR800 crores.
guidance.quote: And we are expecting organic growth of 10%-15% on every year basis, that is point number one.

guidance.claim: Management aims to achieve a profit after tax (PAT) margin of 7% in the near future.
guidance.quote: We are, we have taken an internal target of achieving PAT at the rate 7% in the near future, and we are working on it.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates a PAT margin of 7% by FY28.
guidance.quote: So we are aiming for a PAT of 7% by the FY 28.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that India's FMCG sector continues to offer attractive long-term growth potential.
demand_outlook.quote: India's FMCG sector continues to offer attractive long-term growth potential supported by rising consumption, increasing penetration, and growing demand across categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal care and home care are the categories currently contributing substantially to the FMCG business.
demand_outlook.quote: In the FMCG category, both in the personal care and home care, these two are the categories which are contributing substantially as of now.

demand_outlook.claim: Consolidated revenue grew in Q4 FY26 supported by healthy demand across personal care, home-care, FMCG intermediates, and Edible’s categories.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q4 FY26, consolidated revenue increased by 92.32% YoY to ₹197.59 crore, supported by healthy demand across personal care, home-care, FMCG intermediates, and Edible’s categories.

capex_expansion.claim: The Guwahati facility was successfully commissioned and revamped, enhancing capabilities in soap noodles and cosmetics.
capex_expansion.quote: The successful commissioning and revamp of our Guwahati facility has enhanced our capabilities in soap noodles and cosmetics while improving our reach in the Northeast and other adjacent markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the INR1,000 crores revenue target can be achieved using existing capacities without major capex investments.
capex_expansion.quote: So this INR1,000 crores turnover can be achieved with the existing capacity and we don't see much of the expansion or investment in the capex side for achieving this INR1,000 crores topline.

capex_expansion.claim: The Bhilwara facility became fully operational with monthly capacities of 850 MT in savories and 650 MT in spices.
capex_expansion.quote: • Entry into Edibles: Bhilwara facility became fully operational with monthly capacities of 850 MT in savories and 650 MT in spices, contributing since September 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The Guwahati facility was commissioned with monthly capacities of 2,160 MT for soap noodles and 1,000 MT for cosmetics.
capex_expansion.quote: • Capacity Expansion – FMCG: Commissioned the Guwahati facility with monthly capacities of 2,160 MT for soap noodles and 1,000 MT for cosmetics, strengthening the pan-India footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The Guwahati facility was commissioned in January 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The Guwahati facility, commissioned in January 2026, has installed capacities of approximately 2,160 metric ton per month for soap noodles and 1,000 metric ton for cosmetic products.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin increased to 10.19% compared to 9.31% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, profitability improved during the quarter with EBITDA margin increasing to 10.19% in Q4 FY26 from 9.31% in Q3 FY26, while PAT margin improved to 6.12% from 5.74%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that year-over-year EBITDA and PAT margins went down mainly because of the product mix.
margins_costs.quote: So the Y-o-Y EBITDA and PAT margin went down just because of the product mix.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded to 10.19% in Q4 FY26 from 9.31% in Q3 FY26 due to operating leverage and improving capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, despite FMCG contributing the majority of revenues, profitability continued to improve, with EBITDA margin expanding to 10.19% in Q4 FY26 from 9.31% in Q3 FY26 and PAT margin improving to 6.12% from 5.74%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q3 FY26 stood at INR 15.26 crores, reflecting a year-over-year growth of 158%.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR15.26 crores, reflecting a YoY growth of 158%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q3 FY26 stood at INR 9.41 crores, registering a year-over-year growth of 328%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR9.41 crores, registered a year-over-year growth of 328%, reflecting improved scale, better absorption of fixed costs, and disciplined financial management.

orders_capacity.claim: Sunrakshakk operates a manufacturing network across Bhilwara, Roorkee, and Guwahati, combined with a customer base of over 200 customers.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing network across Bhilwara, Roorkee, and Guwahati combined with a customer base of over 200 customers provides a strong foundation for our future growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Cosmetics capacity utilization at the Guwahati plant is around 45% to 50%.
orders_capacity.quote: So in our Guwahati unit, the cosmetics segment we are utilizing our capacity at around 45% to 50% for Guwahati.

orders_capacity.claim: Total FMCG and FMCG intermediary chemicals capacity stands at 19,640 tons per month.
The Guwahati facility has installed capacities of approximately 2,160 metric ton per month for soap noodles and 1,000 metric ton for cosmetic products.
orders_capacity.quote: The Guwahati facility, commissioned in January 2026, has installed capacities of approximately 2,160 metric ton per month for soap noodles and 1,000 metric ton for cosmetic products.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization in FMCG is operating at somewhere around 40% to 45%.
orders_capacity.quote: So in FMCG, because the capacities are being added recently, right. So we are operating at somewhere 40%-45% of capacities as of now.

capital_allocation.claim: The successful capital raise through the preferential issue strengthened the balance sheet and enhanced the ability to invest in manufacturing capacity and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: Another important development during the year was the successful capital raise through the preferential issue. The fundraised has strengthened our balance sheet and enhanced our ability to invest in manufacturing capacity, working capital requirement, and future growth opportunities.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the preferential issue proceeds, approximately INR55 crores was utilized for the FMCG segment and the rest for the edible section, with INR10 crores held in a fixed deposit.
capital_allocation.quote: So out of that preferential, most of the fund is being utilized for expanding our manufacturing facility in edible category and the FMCG Guwahati unit. Remaining amount is, and if I say, 55 tentatively, INR55 crores we had utilized for FMCG segment and rest I believe 10, our INR10 crores FD is available with us and remaining amount we had used for edible section.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹98.65 crore to support expansion and the acquisition of Sunrakshak Agro Products Pvt. Ltd.
capital_allocation.quote: • Robust Growth: Achieved highest-ever consolidated turnover and raised ₹98.65 crore to support expansion.

capital_allocation.claim: The company split its share in the ratio of 1:5 during the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: We also split our share in the ratio of 1:5 during this financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted a bit of pressure on pricing at the end of Quarter 4 and the beginning of Q1 FY26, though supplies faced no challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: So definitely there was a bit pressure in terms of pricing during the end of the Quarter 4 and the beginning of Q1 FY26. With regard to supplies, we don't force or we didn't face any challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to risks including general market, macro-economic, governmental and regulatory trends.
risks_headwinds.quote: These factors include, but are not limited to, general market, macro-economic, governmental and regulatory trends, movements in currency exchange and interest rates, competitive pressures, technological developments, changes in the financial conditions of third parties dealing with us, legislative developments, and other key factors that could affect our business and financial performance.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve approximately INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: As shared earlier, our medium-term aspirations remain to achieve approximately INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Management is working toward achieving an internal target of 7% PAT margin in the near future.
management_commitments.quote: We are, we have taken an internal target of achieving PAT at the rate 7% in the near future, and we are working on it.

management_commitments.claim: The company maintains its focus on achieving an aspiration of approximately ₹1,000 crore in revenue by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: With a diversified portfolio, expanding customer base, and majority revenues now coming from FMCG and FMCG Intermediates, we remain focused on sustaining growth momentum and achieving our aspiration of approximately ₹1,000 crore in revenue by FY28, while continuing to drive profitable growth and long-term value creation for all stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company is aiming for a PAT of 7% by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So we are aiming for a PAT of 7% by the FY 28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
